note: First receipt layer of the Microsoft Fabric full-corpus integration branch (feat/fabric-corpus-20261105). It records only audited, reviewed transitions made on that branch; it never edits an older receipt and never rewrites a hash that still matches disk. The pinned baseline remains 3d94030; every entry states why it exists and names its work-package review evidence in docs/fabric-corpus/reports/.

files.note: Deterministic sitemap timestamps: two clean builds of the same tree produced different lastmod stamps (new Date() at build time), which the label-differentiated release manifests and --compare-manifest gate correctly flagged as the first real reproducibility defect. The sitemap now honors the reproducible-builds SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH convention (CI pins it to the release commit time) with the corpus integration freeze date (2026-11-05) as the deterministic fallback. No URL, priority or entry set changed. Evidence: docs/fabric-corpus/reports/w4a-report.md.

Lead merge step per the ownership contract's shared-page rule: adds the Official documentation library strip below the Fabric subject home, rendering deterministic per-topic article and held counts from the FC06 binding ledger (build-time fs reads, no client JS; held rows are counts, not links). The SubjectHome content, metadata and canonical are unchanged. Evidence: docs/fabric-corpus/reports/fc06-report.md.

Lead merge step per the ownership contract's shared-page rule: renders the FC06 ReadingCollections component below TopicDesk on every subject/topic desk. The component is self-guarding (null for non-Fabric subjects and unbound topics), so existing desks render unchanged; params flow, metadata and generateStaticParams are untouched. Evidence: docs/fabric-corpus/reports/fc06-report.md.

Minimal two-edit change reviewed by the lead: swaps the search page's client import to the FC07 wrapper SearchWithFabric (app/search/search-with-fabric.tsx) that renders the untouched metadata results plus the Fabric documentation results band, and adds one visible sentence to the existing privacy copy. The metadata index, scoring and question exclusions are unchanged (regression fixture in tests/fabric-corpus/search/fixtures/ asserts byte-identical top-10 for 5 queries; 13/13 existing search tests pass). Evidence: docs/fabric-corpus/reports/fc07-report.md.

Adds three ignore entries for generated integration outputs so compiled media, alias HTML and search shards never enter Git history: /public/fabric-docs-assets/ and /public/fabric-aliases/ (FC05, Wave 2 commit e35724c, reviewed by the lead) and /public/fabric-search/ (FC07, added by the lead). Required by RELEASE_AND_STORAGE.md 'Never in Git history: upstream checkouts, raw private evidence, generated HTML/indexes/media'. All three paths are regenerated by their package build scripts. REC-03 (6 Nov 2026): the final-review successor audit re-derives this exact trailing block from auditedAppend above.
